name: Gagasan Nadi Cergas Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公告任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。年内主要事项为派发2025财年每股2.0仙的中期股息，以及进行凭单发行等企业活动。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts for its business segments. The main events during the year were the declaration of an interim dividend of 2.0 sen per share for FY2025 and corporate exercises such as the bonus issue of warrants.
